title: Overhead Calligraphy Crafting Shot
summary: This prompt generates a beautifully styled overhead shot of a crafting table with calligraphy supplies. It aims for soft lighting and fine detail, perfect for inspiring creative hobbyists on social media.
prompt: A beautifully styled overhead shot of a crafting table where someone is practicing calligraphy. The scene includes a bottle of black ink, a dip pen, a sheet of high-quality paper with elegant lettering, and a few dried flowers for decoration. The lighting is soft and focused on the calligraphy. The image should be serene and inspiring, perfect for a creative hobbyist’s Instagram feed, showcasing fine detail and object placement. –ar 1:1
